label: Prebiotic chemistry
description: Prebiotic synthesis experiments (peptides, nucleotides, ...): one row per experiment sample, with the starting solution chemistry, conditions and measured products. Columns derived from PaperDataTemplate.xlsx (trimmed).

variable_categories.label: Chemical Species
variable_categories.description: dissolved species (reactants, products, salts, catalysts) with no column of their own; concentrations in mM, yields in %

variable_categories.label: Solution Preparation
variable_categories.description: how the starting solutions were made and combined: volumes added, stock solutions, buffers, degassing

variable_categories.label: Reaction Conditions
variable_categories.description: a quantity the reaction ran under that has no column: reaction time, reactor or headspace volume, residence time, stirring rate, irradiation wavelength or power
